title: Theme pages: give the comparison grid real rows and fix Nocturne off-card contrast

source.ref: Visual sweep 2026-11-02: axe WCAG 2.1 AA crawl of /themes/nocturne, /themes/network, /themes/designer, /themes/temple

detail:
The 'What carries to each surface' grid carried role="table" with no row children on all four pages (aria-required-children), and on Nocturne the column headers sat outside any row (aria-required-parent). Each page now wraps the header cells in a row and marks body rows, row headers and cells. The row wrappers stay display:contents so the layout is unchanged. Nocturne's 'off' cards (the Kit inspector) dimmed whole cards with opacity .55, which failed colour contrast on five labels; they now use a transparent card with a hairline instead.

 Fixed 2026-11-02.
